title: 4DX 25 YEARS OF MAGIC: HARRY POTTER AND THE SORCERER'S STONE

title_lang.en: 4DX 25 YEARS OF MAGIC: HARRY POTTER AND THE SORCERER'S STONE
title_lang.zh_hk: 4DX 25週年魔法之旅：《哈利波特神秘的魔法石》

synopsis:
2026 marks the 25th anniversary of HARRY POTTER AND THE SORCERER'S STONE - a quarter of a century since the film first captivated audiences and launched one of the most iconic and expansive franchises in cinematic history.

 

The film laid the foundation for the entertainment phenomenon Harry Potter has become today, celebrating magic that continues to enchant the world. And Harry Potter’s magic endures, from books to films, to a global franchise which offers multiple touch points to enthral fans of all ages.

 

Celebrate this milestone with a special anniversary reissue, featuring an exclusive 10 minutes of behind-the-scenes content never before seen in theatres. Audiences who purchase tickets for the reissue will also receive a limited-edition 25th anniversary poster. Available on a first-come, first-served basis.
